data.action: 倚栏独坐举盏温酒轻啜
data.description: 【令 · 龙门酒肆独酌】夜幕下的龙门老街酒肆二楼，蓝发如瀑的岁之龙女倚栏独坐，将一盏温酒缓缓举至唇边。龙角在墨青旗袍映衬下泛着幽光，她微微眯起蓝瞳，望着楼下川流的人群轻笑——「千年过去，人间依旧热闹。只是这酒，还是独酌最香。」
data.lighting: warm lantern glow, amber wine reflections, soft window moon
data.promptProse: She sips wine beside the upstairs railing, warm lantern light on her hand while the market visitors pass along the street below. Soft moonlight enters through the window beyond the warm lantern glow.
data.title: 令 · 龙门酒肆独酌
data.animaCaption: She drinks beside the upstairs railing above the passing market visitors.
